== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Canna''' is based on the character Kanna Kamui from the anime [[wikipedia:en:Miss_Kobayashi's_Dragon_Maid|''Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid'']].<ref>[https://youtu.be/ZFtrI9VF_rI T1 Canna on being compared to Impact and Duke, which anime his IGN is based in | Ashley Kang] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* His role model is [[Khan]].
*  Following his 3-0 victory over [[Gen.G]] in the [[LCK/2020 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2020 Spring Playoffs]] finals became a ''Royal Roader'', an unofficial achievement earned in Korea after winning a final in a major league as a rookie. 
* Was Diamond I in middle school.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cTaxZmJEXYg&t=387 Wolf: Effort, I love you! | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.1 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Known as "The Pride of Andong", Andong being the city in Korea that Canna is from.<ref>[https://youtu.be/cTaxZmJEXYg?t=121 Wolf: Effort, I love you! | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.1 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref>
** A banner for Canna was put up in Andong during LCK Spring 2020. <ref>[http://www.inven.co.kr/board/lol/4625/2617539]</ref>
* Dubbed by Twitch chat as "GODNA" when performing well, and as "CAN NA" when performing badly.
* Also has the moniker of "Solo Killing Machine" by Korean viewers, and "Solo Kill King" by English viewers for his high number of solo kills in the LCK.
** He was actually close to surpassing [[MaRin | MaRin's]] record in LCK Summer 2020.
* Although the T1 KLEVV ad<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUeq__RmAjE T1 X KLEVV 만들어 봐, 네 본체의 빛]''youtube.com''</ref> that has been touted by some as cringe that transcends space and time, a really good picture of Canna came out of it.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/T1LoL/photos/pcb.2725852250982256/2725849390982542]''facebook''</ref>
* He revealed [[Ellim]] recommended him to join the academy prior to get called for the [[T1]] main roster. <ref>[https://youtu.be/KPg0K7H_lyQ?t=221 Canna shares his story on how he became a pro League of Legends player <nowiki>[</nowiki>T1 Stream Highlight<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* The second player to win both a title in the LCK ([[LCK/2020 Season/Spring Playoffs|LCK 2020 Spring]]) and in the LEC ([[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|LEC 2025 Winter]]) after [[Huni]].<ref>[https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896375277108011359] ''x.com''</ref>
=== Awards ===
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2020)
* LEC 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2025)
